top_stories.title: Semperis Researcher Discovers Critical Active Directory Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities
top_stories.summary: A Semperis researcher discovered two critical Active Directory privilege escalation vulnerabilities, dubbed ResetNightmare and KerberLoss. The flaws exploit weaknesses in how identity systems interpret usernames and service names, enabling attackers to potentially disrupt services, weaken authentication, or impersonate privileged users.

top_stories.title: Entra CAE gives service principals an instant token kill switch
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra has extended Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) to support service principals, enabling administrators to invalidate bearer tokens immediately upon the next resource request rather than waiting up to 90 minutes for expiration. This update addresses a key security gap in non-human identity access control, allowing near-real-time token revocation for service principals in emergency scenarios.

top_stories.title: Cisco bets on Teleport to put identity on every server, workload, and AI agent
top_stories.summary: Cisco is investing in Teleport and integrating its infrastructure-access technology across its portfolio to assign cryptographic identities to servers, laptops, workloads, network devices, and AI agents. The partnership targets the elimination of standing credentials in favor of identity-based access for infrastructure and machine identities.

top_stories.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
top_stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" is being sold for $320 per month, enabling adversary-in-the-middle attacks that steal Microsoft 365 session cookies to bypass authentication. The kit targets session tokens rather than just credentials, allowing attackers to circumvent MFA protections on Microsoft 365 accounts.

top_stories.title: Snowflake ends service-account passwords. Now comes the hard part
top_stories.summary: Snowflake is eliminating password authentication for legacy service accounts, requiring organizations to migrate to passwordless authentication methods. The migration challenge centers on non-human identity management issues: identifying account dependencies, establishing ownership, and right-sizing access privileges for service accounts.

news.title: NovaCookies Campaigns Abuse Genuine Docusign Notifications to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed a new adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) phishing toolkit called NovaCookies that proxies Microsoft 365 sign-ins to steal authenticated session cookies, effectively bypassing MFA. The $320/month subscription service abuses legitimate DocuSign notifications to lure victims, capturing session tokens to enable unauthorized account access.

news.title: CISA Red Team Compromised Two Critical Infrastructure Orgs, One Detected Nothing
news.summary: CISA published results of two simultaneous red team assessments against critical infrastructure organizations, both of which were fully compromised at the domain level. One organization detected nothing during the assessment, highlighting significant gaps in defensive capabilities relevant to identity and access controls.

news.title: Fake Apple Support AI Calls Target Stolen-Device Owners for Passcodes and 2FA Codes
news.summary: Researchers at SOCRadar identified a phishing-as-a-service platform called AnonyMousKIT that uses AI voice agents to impersonate Apple Support and trick theft victims into revealing device passcodes and 2FA codes. The platform is credit-metered and targets Apple's Activation Lock system to enable stolen device access.

news.title: Remote Help for Windows adds unattended remote sign-in
news.summary: Microsoft has added unattended remote sign-in support to Intune Remote Help for Windows, enabling authorized helpdesk staff to access managed devices without a user present. The helper operates in a separate Windows session while any existing user session remains intact.

news.title: EntraFalcon V20260824
news.summary: EntraFalcon is a lightweight PowerShell tool designed to assess the security posture of Microsoft Entra ID environments. It identifies privileged objects, risky role assignments, and potential misconfigurations within Entra ID tenants.

news.title: WhatsApp Adds Multiple Passkeys for Phishing-Resistant Sign-Ins Across iOS and Android
news.summary: Meta has added support for multiple passkeys to a single WhatsApp account, enabling phishing-resistant sign-ins across both iOS and Android devices. The feature expands on passkey support first introduced for Android in October 2023, with Meta reporting over 1 billion users now using passkeys to log into WhatsApp.

news.title: Mirage2FA Surge Hits 4,500 US and EU Companies, Abusing Microsoft 365 Login Flows
news.summary: A phishing-as-a-service toolkit called Mirage2FA has targeted 4,500 US and EU companies between 2024 and 2026, specifically abusing Microsoft 365 login flows to bypass two-factor authentication. According to ANY.RUN research, 48% of targeted email addresses were potentially compromised, with the majority of affected organizations being US-based.

news.title: Attackers Target miniOrange SAML Flaws That Can Grant WordPress Admin Access
news.summary: Attackers are actively exploiting two critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-61979, CVSS 8.1) in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On WordPress plugin. The flaws allow unauthenticated attackers to log in as any WordPress user, including administrators, as disclosed by Patchstack.

news.title: Actively Exploited Oracle WebLogic Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Access Critical Data
news.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-21962, a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) vulnerability in Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle WebLogic Server, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via HTTP to access critical data, making it directly relevant to authentication and access control concerns in enterprise environments.

news.title: M&A Is Quietly Driving a Surge in Cloud Migration
news.summary: The article discusses how mergers and acquisitions are driving cloud migration projects, with identity consolidation being a key component of post-deal IT integration. The piece focuses on the challenge of unifying users, identities, applications, and devices from separate environments following M&A activity.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now provides a Java plugin for the AWS SDK
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has released a Java plugin for the AWS SDK v2 that allows workloads running outside of AWS to obtain temporary AWS credentials directly within the Java application process. The plugin integrates with the SDK's credential provider chain, enabling non-AWS workloads to authenticate using X.509 certificates without requiring external credential helper processes.

news.title: Shadow Agents, Standing Privileges, and the Governance Gap Between Deployment and Discovery
news.summary: The article addresses the emerging IAM challenge of AI agents operating with standing privileges and outside traditional identity governance frameworks. It focuses on the governance gap created when autonomous AI workflows are deployed without proper discovery, access controls, or privileged access management oversight.

news.title: Entra ID memberOf retirement exposes silent group and agent-account risks
news.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the `memberOf` operator on November 3, 2026, causing affected dynamic groups, administrative units, and entitlement policies to freeze without visible errors. Organizations must audit and update affected configurations before the deadline to avoid silent access control failures.

news.title: ShinyHunters taunts ReliaQuest after its own employee falls for social engineering attack
news.summary: ReliaQuest confirmed an employee fell for a social engineering attack, providing attackers with a password and temporary access to the company's identity system. The incident was publicized after extortion group ShinyHunters taunted the cybersecurity firm following the breach.

news.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Cisco Security Platform and Netskope
news.summary: AWS Secrets Manager has expanded its managed external secrets capability to support automatic rotation of Cisco Security Platform API keys and Netskope API tokens. This update allows users to rotate these third-party credentials directly from the AWS console without custom code.

news.title: Q2 Earnings Report Preview: What To Look For
news.summary: Okta is scheduled to release its Q2 earnings report on Wednesday afternoon. The preview notes Okta beat analyst revenue expectations last quarter with $765 million in revenue, representing 11.2% year-over-year growth.

news.title: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies
news.summary: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies, expanding access control capabilities for platform admins and security teams. This update enables granular permission definitions using the complete AWS IAM policy feature set for Lambda functions.

news.title: Microsoft Entra August 2026: Windows SSO control, Exchange attribute writeback, Lifecycle Workflows, and Cloud Sync
news.summary: Microsoft published its August 2026 Microsoft Entra feature roundup, announcing generally available updates including Windows SSO prompt control, Exchange Online attribute writeback via Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync, and Lifecycle Workflows enhancements. The release covers multiple identity and access management capabilities across SSO, cloud synchronization, and identity governance workflows.

news.title: Treasury launches task force to prepare financial sector for quantum cyber threats
news.summary: The U.S. Treasury has launched a public-private task force to prepare the financial sector for quantum computing cyber threats. The task force will focus on migrating financial institutions to quantum-resistant cryptography and addressing risks from vendors and digital assets.

news.title: Hackers target WordPress sites in miniOrange auth bypass attacks
news.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting two critical authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On plugin for WordPress. The flaws allow attackers to forge SAML responses and gain administrator-level access to affected WordPress sites.

news.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
news.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposed master keys to the password vault, affecting MSPs and SMBs that rely on the product. The flaw has been patched, but concerns remain about the security risks inherent in cloud-based password vault architectures.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based access to Snowflake accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights gaps in credential management, secrets detection, and third-party contractor access controls relevant to IAM and PAM practices.
